adopted_by: Logan Municipal Code / Utah six-member form (Mayor + 5 at-large council; at-large since 1975; no geographic districts, no wards)
note: DEGENERATE: Logan's council + mayor are elected entirely AT-LARGE — no wards/districts (in place since 1975; geo/CLAUDE.md). The 5 council seats are numbered for the ballot but are NOT geographic districts (the top-N vote-getters win the N open seats). This single row covers the whole city; geometry_ref points at the current city-limits polygon (geo/city_boundary.geojson). Because every seat is at-large, the sub-district address->representative join degenerates to an in/out-of-city-limits check -> all sitting members + mayor. effective_start = repo data floor; the at-large structure predates it.
